messages:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing logistics for next Wed's webinar. Need owners for: recording capture, live captions, post-event clip edits, and replay hosting. Who can take what?

simon: I can own raw recording capture and ensure cloud recording settings (local + cloud). Will check Zoom TOS for retention.

dana: I’ll do live captions vendor (Verbit) handoff and confirm caption ingestion to transcript. Also will own SRT export.

zach: Happy to do clip edits and 0:30 / 1:30 social cuts. Need timestamps ASAP.

alyssa: I can handle replay hosting & analytics — where do you want the replay embedded? Website + Drift bot?

maria: Thanks. Replay should live on marketing.redwood.ai/webinars first, then auto-post to Wistia. Drift bot link in confirmation email.

ops-bot: Reminder: Zoom recording retention policy requires tag #marketing-webinar for 30d auto-archive.

maria: Simon — can you confirm Zoom settings? We need: enable cloud recording (speaker view + gallery fallback), auto-start recording, record separate audio for each participant, and auto-transcribe ON. Also set host to lock and disable participant recording.

simon: Will do. One question: separate audio increases file count, are editors okay with that?

zach: That's fine — separate tracks help audio clean-up. Keep them.

dana: For captions, Verbit needs the Zoom transcript SRT within 1 hour of end. Simon, can you enable auto-transcript and ftp drop to our staging bucket? If not, we’ll pull from cloud after the meeting.

simon: Zoom doesn't ftp directly; will set cloud transcript and push to S3 via the recording webhook. Set a short retention so we can automove.

maria: Cool. For post-event email: we want replay link + TL;DR bullets + CTA to product trial. Draft copy: "Thanks for joining — replay & key takeaways inside. Try Redwood Inference with 50 free credits." Thoughts?

dana: Suggest adding timestamps to the email for each segment so PMs can jump to specific demos.

zach: I'll produce 3 social clips: highlight demo (0:45), architecture deep-dive (1:10), customer Q&A (0:30). Need rough cut by EOD next day.

alyssa: For lead routing: ensure registration form includes utm_source and job title. Send leads to Salesforce Campaign 'Webinar-Apr-2026' via Zapier, and add a tag for "watched-live" if they attend. Non-attendees get nurture flow.

maria: @zach can you make sure the clips have captions burned-in for social? Also export VTT for accessibility.

zach: Yep — burned captions + separate VTT. Will handoff to design for thumbnails.

maria: Ops checklist before start (Simon to confirm):
- Zoom meeting pre-set with co-hosts (maria, simon, dana)
- Recording settings: cloud, separate audio, transcript ON
- Auto-record for host only
- Add "Do not record" banner for panelists who opt-out
- Slack channel #webinar-live for stage cueing
- OBS stream backup to RTMP in case Zoom drops

simon: ACK on checklist. Will post meeting config snippet in the channel.

ops-bot: Scheduled reminder: webinar-preflight at 2026-04-06T09:00Z in #marketing.

maria: Post-event deadlines: raw files + transcript to editors within 2 hours, first rough clips 24h, final assets + email send 48h. Who owns the send?

alyssa: I will own the 48h email send. Please deliver final replay URL and approved copy 36h post-event.

dana: I'll QA captions within 6h of transcript deliver.

zach: ETA for rough cuts 20–22 hours depending on recording size.

maria: Great. Final note: registration page tracking — include hidden fields for account_id if enterprise leads come from SSO partners. Also add cookie banner for EU consent.

alyssa: Noted. I'll add cookie notice and GDPR checkbox.

maria: Awesome. Last ask — keep the recording filenames consistent: webinar_2026-04-07_<speaker>_<segment>.zip. Simon please automate that naming in the S3 push.

simon: I'll script it and post the webhook mapping in this thread tonight.

maria: Thanks team — feel free to drop updates here. :rocket:
